say:37:1861111021:0.source_cn: 我看到修缮屋没人，就出来找你们。卖南瓜的那个小伙子告诉...

say:39:1861111023:0.text: Ah, I picked it up on my way here. I heard pumpkin lanterns have become quite a hit in Novaris lately.
say:39:1861111023:0.source_cn: 哦，回来的路上顺手买的。听说这东西最近在诺珐斯很流行。

say:40:1861111024:0.text: And everyone's trading this Reverie Candy with each other. They say it lets us Graveborn feel alive again for a little while. I wonder if it works on humans too. Want to give it a try?
say:40:1861111024:0.source_cn: 还有旧梦糖果，外面许多人都在互相交换，据说是能够让亡灵...

say:41:1861111025:0.text: I brought back a few of my favorite flavors for everyone to try.
say:41:1861111025:0.source_cn: 我特意挑了几种我觉得口味不错的带回来给你们的。

say:42:1861111026:0.text: So, does that mean you're willing to try the candy?
say:42:1861111026:0.source_cn: 所以你不会抵触感受到生前的感觉？

say:44:1861111028:0.text: We're just worried... you might feel even worse afterward, since the effect only lasts for a fleeting moment.
say:44:1861111028:0.source_cn: 我们怕……旧梦糖果的效果短暂，会让你产生失落感。

say:45:1861111029:0.text: Come on, I'm not that fragile. If I can't face my past, then I can't stand here as "Baden".
say:45:1861111029:0.source_cn: 你们啊，把我想得太脆弱了。如果连面对过去的勇气都没有，...

say:47:1861111031:1.text: If that's the case, I want you to have this!

say:48:1861111032:1.text: Oh? You made this for me? I've got to try it.
say:48:1861111032:1.source_cn: 哦？你特意准备的糖果？那我可要好好品鉴一下了。

say:49:1861111033:0.text: Baden puts the candy into his mouth. As it melts on his tongue, a deep blue slowly fills his vision.
say:49:1861111033:0.source_cn: 巴登将爱丝准备的糖果放入口中，随着糖果在口中融化，一抹...

say:51:1861111035:0.text: Yeah! Is it cloudless and full of stars? Just like the sky we saw back then?
say:51:1861111035:0.source_cn: 嗯！看到了吗？深蓝色的夜空，满天的星星，没有一点乌云！...

say:52:1861111036:0.text: Ah, that night! I remember a certain little girl got lost and was scared to tears. But when we found her, she insisted she was just taking the scenic route!
say:52:1861111036:0.source_cn: 我还记得那天晚上，有人迷了路之后害怕得要命，明明眼眶都...

say:53:1861111037:1.text: How time flies. Now that little girl has grown up to lead House Rayne.
say:53:1861111037:1.source_cn: 一转眼，那个小女孩已经成长为能够独当一面的瑞恩家族家主了。

say:54:1861111038:1.text: It's a beautiful memory, and I'm really glad I get to relive it.
say:54:1861111038:1.source_cn: 这么好的回忆，我怎么会不愿意再体验一次呢？

say:56:1861111040:0.text: Oh, Thane's got one for you too! Where is it, Thane?
say:56:1861111040:0.source_cn: 对了，瑟恩也为你准备了糖果！瑟恩，快拿出来呀。

say:58:1861111042:1.text: Heh, I already have a pretty good idea what it'll taste like.
say:58:1861111042:1.source_cn: 哈，我大概知道会是什么。

say:59:1861111043:1.text: Baden tastes the candy and lets out a soft chuckle a moment later.
say:59:1861111043:1.source_cn: 巴登把糖含入口中，过了一会儿，轻轻笑了一声。

say:60:1861111044:1.text: This smoky flavor of mushrooms and wild greens...
say:60:1861111044:1.source_cn: 蘑菇，野菜，还有这股特殊的烟熏味……

say:61:1861111045:1.text: It tastes like that stew you made for me when we got trapped in the mountains together.
say:61:1861111045:1.source_cn: 是我们一起被困在山上那次，你做给我吃的野菜汤。

say:62:1861111046:1.text: Even now, I still think it's the best thing I've ever had.
say:62:1861111046:1.source_cn: 我说过，那是我有生以来吃过最好吃的东西。这个评价到现在...

say:63:1861111047:1.text: I've become a much better cook since then. Too bad you can't try what I make now.
say:63:1861111047:1.source_cn: 我现在的厨艺比当初精进多了，可惜，你吃不出我新菜式的手艺了。

say:64:1861111048:1.text: Hey, don't count me out just yet. You can turn your new dishes into candy for me to try next year!
say:64:1861111048:1.source_cn: 那可说不定。既然旧梦糖果能复现味道，不如把你做的新菜式...

say:66:1861111050:1.text: Alright, let's save the sentimental stuff for another time.
say:66:1861111050:1.source_cn: 好了，别的感慨就留到以后再说吧。

say:67:1861111051:1.text: The whole city is celebrating Fall Harvest outside! Let's join in the fun!
say:67:1861111051:1.source_cn: 诺珐斯的秋夜节可是很热闹的。走吧，我们去好好享受秋夜节！
